notes.subject: בלב ולב
notes.rationale: Heburu: 'ni dusukun ni ni dusukun' — dusukun fila, kuma fila; Bamanankan de sɔn 'dusukun ni dusukun sira fila la'

notes.subject: שפת חלקות
notes.rationale: kɔrɔ ka ɲɛ: 'da-nɔgɔyaw' (numannyaw); Heburu 'da min bɛ nɔgɔya'

notes.subject: ידברו…ידברו
notes.rationale: kuma-kelen in tuubu kumasen daminɛ ni a laban na — a bɛ jo; Bamanankan 'bɛ fɔ' tuubuya ka jira nɔgɔya

notes.subject: ⟨dusukun kelen ni kelen sira fila la⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan ka 'בלב ולב' cogo kelen na, Bamanankan de filanɛ dɔ sɔn ka a faamuya

translation: Fiyenw bɛ fɔ mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ a tɔgɔntigi ni ⟨את⟩ a jɛlijɛla ye; numannya-lenw bɛɛ ni dusukun fila ⟨dusukun kelen ni kelen sira fila la⟩ bɛ fɔ.
